title: CLEO: Reinforcement Learning-Optimized Synthetic Data Generation
summary: CLEO is a reinforcement-learning framework that tunes Gaussian Mixture Model hyperparameters via Q-Learning to generate privacy-preserving synthetic medical data, evaluated on fidelity, utility, and privacy metrics. Its comparison scripts (gan.py, TVAE.py, copula.py) instantiate SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer as baseline models benchmarked against CLEO's own GMM-based generator.
